args.lesson: Verdict STOP for a paid version of the color/size catalogue transformation. Three candidates were checked. Matrixify: the vendor pricing page returned 403, but the Shopify App Store listing gave Demo free/10 products, Basic $20/mo with 5K products per file, Big $50/mo, Enterprise $200/mo, and 1,868 ratings (ratings, not paying users). LitExtension: automated migration from $19, done-for-you AIO from $129 per project, priced by entity count. Cart2Cart returned 403. None of them prices this exact reshaping as a standalone deliverable, the free native importer is the baseline, and collection is blocked, so no economic advantage is established. What worked: when a vendor site returns 403, the official app-marketplace listing is a fetchable source for the same candidate. What failed: guessing a deep URL gave a 404. Next time, take URLs from links on a page already fetched. Do not reopen Shopify pricing work unless a classified request arrives.
